basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, TX, who recently dove into the world of 3D printing. I work as a software developer during the day and enjoy experimenting with new gadgets and tech in my spare time. I’m single and enjoy spending my evenings online, usually between 7 PM and midnight. I have a growing interest in DIY projects and am currently fascinated by the capabilities of my new 3D printer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for 6 years. While I am new to 3D printing, I have a solid understanding of technology and enjoy learning new skills through online tutorials and community forums.
